source: Schimpe, M., von Kuepach, M. E., Naumann, M., Hesse, H. C., Smith, K., Jossen, A. (2018). Comprehensive modeling of temperature-dependent degradation mechanisms in lithium iron phosphate batteries. Journal of The Electrochemical Society 165(2), A181-A193. https://doi.org/10.1149/2.1181714jes (open access, CC BY 4.0)
cell: Sony US26650FTC1, LiFePO4/graphite, 26650, 3.0 Ah taken as nominal in the study, 2.0 to 3.6 V (Table I, p. A182)
tests: storage at 10 to 55 C and SOC 0 to 100 %; cycle tests CC and CC-CV at 0.25C, 0.5C and 1C (same rate for charge and discharge), 0, 10, 15, 25, 35, 45 and 55 C, full range 2.0 to 3.6 V, CV cut-off C/10 (Table II and text, p. A182)
model: Eq. 23, p. A188: Q_Loss = k_Cal(T,SOC) sqrt(t) + k_Cyc,HighT(T) sqrt(Q_Tot) + k_Cyc,LowT(T,I_Ch) sqrt(Q_Ch) + k_Cyc,LowT,HighSOC(T,I_Ch,SOC) Q_Ch; Q_Loss is the capacity loss as a fraction of the original capacity; time t in h, throughput in Ah; Q_Tot counts charge and discharge, Q_Ch charge only (p. A187); the rate-based integral form, Eq. 24, for varying conditions

stress_factors.k_Cal(T,SOC): k_Cal,Ref * exp[-E_a,Cal/R_g (1/T - 1/T_Ref)] * (exp[alpha F (U_a,Ref - U_a(SOC)) / (R_g T_Ref)] + k_0)   (Eq. 9, p. A185)
stress_factors.k_Cyc,LowT(T,I_Ch): k_Cyc,LowT,Ref * exp[+E_a,Cyc,LowT/R_g (1/T - 1/T_Ref)] * exp[beta_LowT (I_Ch - I_Ch,Ref)/C_0]   (Eq. 18, p. A187)
stress_factors.k_Cyc,LowT,HighSOC(T,I_Ch,SOC): k_Cyc,LowT,HighSOC,Ref * exp[+E_a,Cyc,LowT,HighSOC/R_g (1/T - 1/T_Ref)] * exp[beta_LowT,HighSOC (I_Ch - I_Ch,Ref)/C_0] * (sgn(SOC - SOC_Ref) + 1)/2   (Eq. 21, p. A188)

C_0_Ah.where: p. A187 (nominal cell capacity C_0 = 3 Ah)

other.end_of_test: tests stopped at 80 % of the original capacity; the model does not include accelerating (non-linear) ageing (p. A183)

25C_1C_CC.text: As the cells show a high cycle stability at 25 C, with less than 9% of capacity loss after 2800 full cycles at 1C

45C_1C_CC.text: the test point CC cycling at ambient temperature of 45 C with 1C showed a capacity loss of 12% ... after 2800 full equivalent cycles

model_error_CC.text: For all cells except 0 C cycled at 1C, the model error is below 2%
